65e23f340d4561000821540d: King Friday recites his kingly version of Twinkle Twinkle Little Star as Prince Tuesday struggles to write a poem of his own. Mrs. McFeely is watching a litter of sixteen-day-old puppies and explains the care that they need.
Mr. McFeely brings a video showing how people make vacuum cleaners.

Mister Rogers takes viewers to B. Smith's Restaurant. After viewing the restaurant's walk-in refrigerator, Mister Rogers and Ms. Smith make a custard dessert. Barbara Smith gives Queen Sara a napkin commemorating her new restaurant.

Mister Rogers shows a video about how people make chalk. Mayor Maggie reports that all of the vacuum sweepers in Westwood are missing. King Friday assigns Lady Aberlin, Mayor Maggie and Prince Tuesday to find the missing vacuums.
Mister Rogers meets with some children who are making crafts at the Inner City Art Center in Los Angeles. In Make-Believe, Lady Elaine's friends help her conquer her fears.

Mister Rogers and Mr. McFeely look at snow globes and see a film about how people make cereal. King Friday says he is the bravest and strongest in the neighborhood. Cereal is falling like snow. Mister Rogers goes to a Tae Kwon Do class.

Mister Rogers returns a scarf to one of Mr. Brewer's puppets which makes the puppet feel brave and strong. Elsie Jean Platypus tells Lady Abelrin that the cereal quit falling on her because she was not afraid of it.

Mister Rogers visits the McFeelys, who are watching after young lambs. Handyman Negri and King Friday put on full cereal-proof armor. When their efforts fail, it is clear that Daniel is the only one who can stop the cereal from falling.

Mister Rogers demonstrates how to use tuning whistles. Daniel has the idea to give the cereal to people who might need food. Neighbor Aber brings a forklift to gather all the boxes. Mr. McFeely brings a video about how people make it.
Mister Rogers remembers a time when he visited Jay Styperk, a para-Olympic swimmer. King Friday's crown has gone missing. He hesitantly enters the castle garden, wearing his swimming cap and goggles.

Mister Rogers uses objects from his kitchen to make a horse sculpture. Prince Tuesday is dressed in a lion costume and startles Mayor Maggie. He explains that wearing the costume helps him feel brave about looking for his father's crown.
Mr. McFeely delivers a video about how people make apple juice. King Friday suggests that Lady Aberlin start looking for his missing crown at the Museum-Go-Round.

Mister Rogers arrives with a fish sculpted from the paper by his friend Ben Gonzales.  Edgar Cooke shares with Lady Aberlin that his refrigerator and food are gone. She finds it, along with King Friday's crown and the Westwood sign.

Bill Nye, “the Science Guy” stops by to show a science experiment using baking soda and vinegar to blow up a balloon. Mister Rogers shows a video of dump trucks at a construction site, and in Make-Believe, all that was lost is found.

Magician David Copperfield teaches Mister Rogers how to do a magic trick. It takes lots of practice. In Make-Believe, X is giving flying lessons, and there's a video of what the world looks like from a bird's point of view.

Prince Tuesday is upset about being unable to fly, so Lady Elaine gives him a propeller hat. He jumps off the castle wall, thinking the hat will make him fly, and injures his arm. Mister Rogers visits the Uptown String Quartet.

X says he is feeling guilty about Prince Tuesday's fall. Neighbor Aber says it was not X's flying lessons that made Prince Tuesday get hurt. Mister Rogers shows a video about people making sleeping bags. He visits the workshop of the doll maker.
Hula-hoop expert Paul Tifford gives Mister Rogers some lessons. It takes a lot of practice to be able to use a hula-hoop well, and falling and getting up again are a part of learning!
Instead of changing into a sweater as he typically does, Mister Rogers puts on a vest made by his friend Saihou Njie. Trolley brings a batik cloth to Handyman Negri, who then gives it to King Friday.

Mister Rogers arrives with a children's plastic potty, takes it to his bathroom and compares it to the adult-sized toilet. Prince Tuesday comes up with a game using a bucket but has had his feelings hurt when his father was not impressed.

King Friday denounces the magic finder balloon. Neighbors Aber and Robert Troll are looking for Lady Elaine. They find her locked in a room of the Museum-Go-Round. At Mister Rogers' house, Levar Burton reads “The Daddy Book.”

Mister Rogers explains how a wheelchair lift works, and then shows one in action. He shows some of his puppets. Mayor Maggie and Neighbor Aber ride in a wheelchair until they have their checkups from Dr. Bill.

Mister Rogers visits with Koko the gorilla, who has learned how to communicate in sign language. In Make-Believe, there's a gorilla, too, who seems scary until the neighbors get to know him. And there's a video of how people make play balls.

At the eye doctor's office, Mister Rogers takes part in a general eye examination. The gorilla catches Lady Aberlin as she stumbles, which alarms Lady Elaine Fairchild. Lady Elaine is determined to catch the gorilla.

Mr. McFeely stops by with a film about a service dog aiding a handicapped child. Mister Rogers visits with the boy from the video and his dog. Lady Elaine Fairchile continues her efforts to catch the gorilla. Neighbor Aber is missing.
Mister Rogers reads a book about a dog named Zak. There's also a video visit to the Center for Creative Play, a place where children of all abilities can play.

Marilyn Barnett brings someone who has great talent with yo-yos. Mister Rogers shows a film of how people make wooden yo-yos. Prince Tuesday plays well with the yo-yo, but King Friday does not. Therefore, the king outlaws yo-yos.

Mister Rogers and Mr. McFeely ride with Maria Mancano on a helicopter. Miss Paulificate and Lady Aberlin have been assigned the duty of “yo-yo guard,” responsible for upholding the King's ban on yo-yos.

Mr. McFeely shows a photo album with pictures of Neighbors wearing different hats. Lady Aberlin informs King Friday that Lady Elaine's helicopter, Yo-Yo, is stuck in the air. King Friday commands that all references to yo-yos be removed.

5ff4b9ccf938f8000779eb99: Flevance, la patria de Law, era un sitio admirado, hermoso y blanco como un país de nieve. Pero esa hermosa patria se vuelve una zona de guerra y desaparece del mapa. Ahora sabremos todas las adversidades por las que pasó Law cuando era niño.

Doflamingo nació siendo uno de los Dragones Celestiales, los gobernantes del mundo. ¿Por qué perdió su posición de nobleza? Cuando se revela el inimaginable pasado de Doflamingo, la vida del joven Law sufre un gran cambio.

Mientras Law se acerca a su muerte, Corazón y él salen en búsqueda de una cura para su enfermedad. Tras un largo y doloroso viaje, Corazón empieza a hablar desde su corazón y, a partir de ese momento, nace un profundo vínculo entre ellos.

¡A Law le queda muy poco tiempo! Corazón planea enemistarse con todo el mundo para robar la fruta Ope Ope y así salvar a Law y vivir con él. La pelea en la que Corazón arriesgará su vida empezará en la fatídica Isla Minion.
Corazon por fin consigue la fruta Ope Ope y se la da a Law para que se la coma, aunque no tiene un efecto inmediato.
La Familia Don Quixote acorrala a Corazón, quien finalmente enfrenta a Doflamingo. Cuando Corazón arriesga su vida para luchar... el joven Law empieza a caminar hacia la libertad.

Cora-san abrió un camino al futuro para Law sacrificando su propia vida.Law hereda su deseo y, con el fin de ser verdaderamente libre, lanza un ataque a Doflamingo que Cora-san no pudo lanzar ese día.

Law lanza ataques mostrando sus apasionadas emociones por el difunto Cora-san. Pero cuando Doflamingo hace una sonrisa temeraria al recibir esos violentos ataques, un terrible contraataque hace que Law caiga en un abismo de desesperación.

Los salvajes ataques de Machvise dejan gravemente herido a Hajrudin y lo hacen desplomarse. Pero cuando el gigante lastimado vuelve a levantarse para pagar su deuda con Luffy, resuena un ataque letal que contiene todo el alma de Elbaf.

Sai, de la Marina Happo, queda confundido cuando Baby 5 lo confronta con sus sentimientos. Mientras ambas familias luchan por defender su honor, se revela su triste pasado, y el apasionado Sai lanza una técnica especial secreta que supera a Don Chinjao.

Después de ser traicionado, manipulado y casi asesinado por su héroe, Doflamingo, Bellamy aún quiere retar a Luffy. Cuando toma su última decisión después de dudar entre la amistad y sus principios, lanza un golpe devastador sobre Luffy.

Mientras Robin y los demás continúan la batalla contra Gladius, Dellinger, el oficial, aparece y cambia la batalla. Cuando parece que no pueden evitar la crisis definitiva, el arma durmiente, Hakuba, despierta e inicia una batalla de velocidad extrema.

Robin retiene a Cavendish tras haber salido a la luz su segunda personalidad, el malvado Hakuba. En ese momento aparece Gladius dispuesto a aprovechar la ocasión y acabar con ellos gracias a sus habilidades.

La Familia Don Quixote queda contra la pared cuando caen sus oficiales. Pero Giolla pone en marcha un secreto que los revivirá. Con el peligro de cambiar la marea de la batalla, empieza la valiente pelea de Leo.
El encuentro de Señor Pink con la mujer que cambió su vida y su melancólico, romántico y memorable pasado se revelan mientras su pelea contra Franky, con sus vidas en juego, llega a su fin.
Finalmente concluye la viril y brutal pelea entre Señor Pink y Franky, así que la acción vuelve a situarse en el Campo de Flores.
Kyros llega a su límite cuando todo su cuerpo recibe incontables bolas con picos.

Doflamingo ataca a Luffy, quien usó toda su energía y no puede moverse. Recuperar su Haki le tomará diez minutos. Empieza una intensa batalla para proteger a Luffy de Doflamingo, que se ha vuelto la encarnación de la ira.
